freePlan.limits: Spelling/grammar corrections, writing-tone detection, and 100 AI prompts per month.

keyLimits.en: Spelling/grammar corrections, writing-tone detection, and 100 AI prompts per month.

Full sentence rewrites, tone adjustment, fluency suggestions, plagiarism and AI-generated-text detection, 2,000 AI prompts/member/month, account roles, up to 2 user groups and 1 style guide/brand tone, team analytics.

Everything in Pro plus proactive AI, dedicated support, BYOK encryption, custom roles, data loss prevention, SAML SSO, SCIM, managed mode, unlimited prompts/style guides/brand tones/user groups, and advanced security controls (confidential mode, audit logs, session timeout).

cautions.en: The $12/mo figure was shown as the Pro plan's price; whether this is a monthly or annual-billed rate was not explicitly labeled on the page and should be re-verified before use in a billing comparison.

capabilities.en: Grammar, spelling and style checking with tone detection across writing surfaces.
AI writing assistance: sentence rewriting, tone adjustment, and fluency suggestions for non-native English writers (Pro).
Team features on Pro/Enterprise: account roles, user groups, shared style guides and brand tone, and team analytics.

limitations.en: AI prompt usage is capped even on the paid Pro plan (2,000 prompts/member/month); the free plan is capped at 100 prompts/month.
Advanced security and compliance features (SSO, SCIM, DLP, BYOK) are Enterprise-only and require a custom quote.

reason.en: General-purpose AI assistant increasingly used for writing/editing tasks that overlap with Grammarly's rewriting and tone features, though without dedicated in-line grammar checking across every app.

missingAlternatives.name: ProWritingAid
missingAlternatives.reason: Direct grammar/style-checking competitor to Grammarly with a similar freemium model; not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: Whether the Pro plan's $12/mo price is billed monthly or annually was not explicitly confirmed on the pricing page.
Team-specific pricing (as opposed to per-seat Pro pricing) was not broken out separately in this pass.
